name: Joaquin
self_text: I’m Joaquin, a 50‑something non‑binary native of Korea who loves to sketch buildings in my spare time. When I’m not drawing, I’m in the world of Skyforge Arena, where I focus on ranked matches and stay in voice chat to coordinate with teammates. I’ve never been in a coaching role—my play is all about personal growth and strategy. Most of my practice sessions happen on weekends, usually Saturday mornings or Sunday mornings, when I can dive into the game without rush. I enjoy the steady rhythm of climbing the ranks, the camaraderie that voice chat brings, and the satisfaction of turning a well‑played match into a story to share over a sketch of a city skyline.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into ranked matches, no exceptions. I'd strongly prefer that you’re available either Saturday morning or Sunday morning, though it’s not a requirement if you can’t make those times.
